title: trump says he would love see united ireland 2026 09 12
text:
DUBLIN, Sept 12 (Reuters) - U.S. President Donald Trump said on ​Saturday he would "love" ‌to see Ireland unify with British-run Northern Ireland and ​that it would ​happen eventually.
"Well, I don't want ⁠to cause any ​problems, but I will ​tell you, I'd love to see it unified," Trump told ​reporters after a ​meeting with Irish Prime Minister Micheal ‌Martin ⁠in Dublin.
"The way I look at it, it's going to happen ​eventually ... I ​think ⁠it would be a fantastic thing."
"Now ​the UK will ​have ⁠something to say about it ... but I think ⁠it ​would be ​a great thing."
